### Faculty Specializing in Astrophysics and Relativity

天体物理与宇宙学

Our astrophysics research programs investigate problems on scales from stars to galaxies to the cosmos. Current experimental interests include ultra-short-period pulsating variable stars, neutron stars, black holes, supernova remnants, interstellar medium, active galactic nuclei, relativistic jets
